annotations.title: Create the Style Sheet project from a plan

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Consumes a plan from plan_design_sheet, spending its quoted credits and creating the project. Calling this again with the same planId after it already succeeded is safe -- it returns the same project rather than creating a second one or charging twice. Returns immediately, before the Style Sheet image has rendered -- call get_pack_status to advance rendering and get designPackage.imageUrl, show it to the user, then call approve_design_sheet once they approve it. plan_overlay_pack refuses to plan any scene on this project until that approval is recorded.
name: create_design_sheet
title: Create the Style Sheet project from a plan
